svg.title: Series RC loop with an unknown capacitance and two voltage readings
svg.desc: A constant 10 volt ideal source, positive at its upper terminal, connects through a 500 ohm resistor to the upper plate of a capacitor. Capacitance C is an unknown positive constant in farads. The capacitor lower plate returns to the source negative terminal on the common zero volt wire. Current i is defined clockwise into the upper capacitor plate. Voltage v is upper plate minus lower plate; v at zero seconds is 2 volts and v at four seconds is 6 volts. The loop remains connected for time at least zero seconds.

g.text: Estimate the capacitance from a voltage reading
One connected series loop · ideal components · t ≥ 0 s
Voltage reference: v = upper-plate potential − lower-plate potential
Loop model: Ri + v = 10 V · Capacitor model: i = C dv/dt
The measurement draws no current; all three components stay connected
Original practice diagram · MTH 256 · Batch 10, Question 10 · Not a course-provided figure
